messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 3.3.5

3.3.5. Control circuit failure A failure in the power supply to the power-assisted steering, where fitted, shall not prevent machinery from being steered during the time required to stop it. For autonomous mobile machinery, a failure in the steering system shall not have an impact on the safety of the machinery.

response.text:
failure in power supply to power-assisted steering | shall not prevent | machinery being steered during the time required to stop it | where power-assisted steering is fitted | A failure in the power supply to the power-assisted steering, where fitted, shall not prevent machinery from being steered during the time required to stop it.
failure in steering system | shall not have an impact on | safety of autonomous mobile machinery | applies to autonomous mobile machinery | For autonomous mobile machinery, a failure in the steering system shall not have an impact on the safety of the machinery.
